content:
# Sierra Vista Area Election Explorer # Static election results for Arizona's 6th congressional district (which # contains Sierra Vista) and its neighbors, AZ-7 and AZ-2, at district, county # and precinct level, 2016-2024. # # Build the data once with: Rscript data-raw/build_data.R # Then run with: shiny::runApp() library(shiny) library(bslib) library(dplyr) library(ggplot2) library(DT) library(leaflet) library(sf) library(plotly) # ---- Data ------------------------------------------------------------------- districts_sf <- readRDS("data/districts.rds") |> rename(geo_id = district) counties_sf <- readRDS("data/counties.rds") |> rename(geo_id = county) precincts_sf <- readRDS("data/precincts.rds") context_sf <- readRDS("data/context.rds") # state outline + AZ's other districts district_info <- read.csv("data/districts.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE) DISTRICTS <- district_info$district # District-level House results come from the official canvass file; everything # else is rebuilt from precinct returns by data-raw/build_data.R. house_official <- read.csv("data/house_results.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE) |> transmute(level = "district", geo_id = district, year, race = "House", party, candidate, votes, estimated = FALSE) # Unofficial 2026 House results (district level only) until the canvass is # certified and precinct returns are published prelim_2026 <- read.csv("data/preliminary_2026.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE) PRELIM_YEARS <- unique(prelim_2026$year) results <- readRDS("data/results.rds") |> filter(!(level == "district" & race == "House")) |> bind_rows(house_official) |> bind_rows(transmute(prelim_2026, level = "district", geo_id = district, year, race = "House", party, candidate, votes, estimated = FALSE)) race_years <- results |> filter(level == "district") |> distinct(race, year) |> arrange(year) years_for <- function(race) race_years$year[race_years$race == race] is_prelim <- function(year) year %in% PRELIM_YEARS year_label <- function(year) ifelse(is_prelim(year), paste(year, "(preliminary)"), as.character(year)) year_choices <- function(years) setNames(years, year_label(years)) RACES <- c("U.S. House" = "House", "President" = "President", "U.S. Senate" = "Senate", "Governor" = "Governor") # Display names for every geography, keyed by geo_id geo_titles <- c( setNames(DISTRICTS, DISTRICTS), setNames(paste(tools::toTitleCase(tolower(counties_sf$geo_id)), "County"), counties_sf$geo_id), setNames(paste0(precincts_sf$precinct_name, " (", tools::toTitleCase(tolower(precincts_sf$county)), " Co.)"), precincts_sf$geo_id) ) district_colors <- c("AZ-6" = "#6A3D9A", "AZ-7" = "#1B9E77", "AZ-2" = "#D95F02") county_colors <- c("#E7298A", "#66A61E", "#E6AB02", "#A6761D", "#666666") SIERRA_VISTA <- c(lng = -110.3037, lat = 31.5545) study_bbox <- unname(st_bbox(districts_sf)) # ---- UI --------------------------------------------------------------------- ui <- page_sidebar( title = "Sierra Vista Area Election Explorer", theme = bs_theme(version = 5, bootswatch = "flatly"), fillable = TRUE, sidebar = sidebar( width = 300, selectInput("race", "Race", choices = RACES), radioButtons("mode", "View", choices = c("Single election" = "single", "Change between years" = "change")), conditionalPanel( "input.mode == 'single'", selectInput("year", "Election year", choices = NULL) ), conditionalPanel( "input.mode == 'change'", layout_columns( selectInput("from", "From", choices = NULL), selectInput("to", "To", choices = NULL) ) ), radioButtons("level", "Map level", inline = TRUE, choices = c("District" = "district", "County" = "county", "Precinct" = "precinct")), selectInput("focus", "Focus district", choices = setNames(DISTRICTS, paste0(DISTRICTS, " — ", district_info$relation)), selected = "AZ-6"), actionButton("zoom_focus", "Zoom map to district", icon = icon("magnifying-glass-location"), class = "btn-sm btn-outline-secondary"), hr(), uiOutput("district_info"), p(class = "small text-muted", "Sources: AZ Secretary of State canvass; MIT Election Data + Science Lab (2022, 2024", "precinct returns); Voting and Election Science Team (2016–2020 precinct shapes);", "NYT 2024 precinct shapes; U.S. Census TIGER boundaries.", "2026 House results are unofficial (as reported Nov 9–10, 2026).", "District lines are the current (2022) map.") ), layout_columns( fill = FALSE, value_box(textOutput("vb1_title"), textOutput("vb1"), showcase = icon("trophy")), value_box(textOutput("vb2_title"), textOutput("vb2"), showcase = icon("scale-balanced")), value_box(textOutput("vb3_title"), textOutput("vb3"), showcase = icon("check-to-slot")) ), navset_card_tab( id = "tabs", nav_panel( "Map", card_body( padding = 0, leafletOutput("map", height = "100%") ), card_footer(class = "small text-muted", uiOutput("map_note")) ), nav_panel( "Trends", layout_columns( col_widths = c(7, 5), card( full_screen = TRUE, card_header( class = "d-flex gap-3 align-items-center flex-wrap", "Margin over time", div(style = "width: 190px; margin-bottom: -1rem;", selectInput("trend_series", NULL, choices = c("Top of ticket" = "top", RACES[-1], "U.S. House" = "House"))), div(style = "min-width: 220px; flex: 1; margin-bottom: -1rem;", selectizeInput("trend_counties", NULL, multiple = TRUE, choices = setNames(counties_sf$geo_id, geo_titles[counties_sf$geo_id]), selected = "COCHISE", options = list(maxItems = 5, placeholder = "Add counties…"))) ), plotlyOutput("trend_plot"), card_footer(class = "small text-muted", "R − D share of all votes. Above zero = Republican lead.", "“Top of ticket” uses president in 2016/2020/2024 and governor in 2018/2022.", "District values for 2016–2020 are estimated onto today’s lines.", "2026 House values are preliminary.") ), card( full_screen = TRUE, card_header(textOutput("swing_title", inline = TRUE)), plotlyOutput("swing_plot"), card_footer(class = "small text-muted", "Bars right = shift toward Republicans; left = toward Democrats.") ) ), card( card_header("Change by district and county"), DTOutput("swing_table") ) ), nav_panel( "Results", plotlyOutput("result_plot") ), nav_panel( "Compare districts", plotlyOutput("compare_plot") ), nav_panel( "Data", layout_columns( fill = FALSE, radioButtons("data_level", NULL, inline = TRUE, choices = c("District" = "district", "County" = "county", "Precinct" = "precinct")), div(class = "text-end", downloadButton("download", "Download CSV", class = "btn-sm")) ), DTOutput("table") ) ) ) # ---- Server ----------------------------------------------------------------- server <- function(input, output, session) { # -- Year pickers follow the race ----------------------------------------- observeEvent(input$race, { yrs <- years_for(input$race) updateSelectInput(session, "year", choices = year_choices(rev(yrs)), selected = max(yrs)) updateSelectInput(session, "from", choices = year_choices(yrs), selected = yrs[length(yrs) - 1]) updateSelectInput(session, "to", choices = year_choices(yrs), selected = max(yrs)) }) sel_year <- reactive({ req(input$year); as.integer(input$year) }) sel_from <- reactive({ req(input$from); as.integer(input$from) }) sel_to <- reactive({ req(input$to); as.integer(input$to) }) # Year shown in single-election views (Results, Compare) shown_year <- reactive(if (input$mode == "change") sel_to() else sel_year()) valid_change <- reactive({ validate(need(sel_from() != sel_to(), "Pick two different years to compare.")) TRUE }) # -- Sidebar info ------------------------------------------------------------ output$district_info <- renderUI({ d <- district_info[district_info$district == input$focus, ] tagList( h6(d$name), p(class = "small mb-1", strong("Representative: "), d$representative), p(class = "small", d$area) ) }) # -- Value boxes --------------------------------------------------------------- focus_margins <- reactive({ results |> filter(level == "district", geo_id == input$focus, race == input$race) |> margin_summary() }) output$vb1_title <- renderText( if (input$mode == "single") paste(input$focus, if (is_prelim(sel_year())) "leader (preliminary)" else "winner") else paste(input$focus, "margin,", year_label(sel_from())) ) output$vb2_title <- renderText( if (input$mode == "single") "Margin" else paste(input$focus, "margin,", year_label(sel_to())) ) output$vb3_title <- renderText( if (input$mode == "single") "Total votes" else "Swing" ) output$vb1 <- renderText({ m <- focus_margins() if (input$mode == "single") { top <- results |> filter(level == "district", geo_id == input$focus, race == input$race, year == sel_year()) |> slice_max(votes, n = 1) sprintf("%s (%s)", top$candidate, substr(top$party, 1, 1)) } else { fmt_margin(m$margin[m$year == sel_from()]) } }) output$vb2 <- renderText({ m <- focus_margins() if (input$mode == "single") fmt_margin(m$margin[m$year == sel_year()]) else fmt_margin(m$margin[m$year == sel_to()]) }) output$vb3 <- renderText({ m <- focus_margins() if (input$mode == "single") { format(round(m$total[m$year == sel_year()]), big.mark = ",") } else { valid_change() fmt_swing(m$margin[m$year == sel_to()] - m$margin[m$year == sel_from()]) } }) # -- Map ----------------------------------------------------------------------- map_data <- reactive({ lvl <- input$level race <- input$race if (input$mode == "single") { yr <- sel_year() shapes <- switch( lvl, district = districts_sf, county = counties_sf, precinct = filter(precincts_sf, geo_set == if (yr >= 2022) "current" else paste0("vest", yr)) ) res <- filter(results, level == lvl, race == !!race, year == yr) vals <- margin_summary(res) |> transmute(geo_id, value = margin) pops <- popup_html(res, geo_titles) |> left_join(vals, by = "geo_id") |> mutate(html = paste0(html, "
Margin: ", fmt_margin(value), "
")) list(shapes = shapes, values = pops, limit = 50, kind = "margin", estimated = FALSE) } else { valid_change() from <- sel_from(); to <- sel_to() res_level <- if (lvl == "precinct") "precinct_current" else lvl shapes <- switch(lvl, district = districts_sf, county = counties_sf, precinct = filter(precincts_sf, geo_set == "current")) s <- swing(filter(results, level == res_level, race == !!race), from, to) |> # A handful of votes makes the margin meaningless; leave those grey mutate(swing = ifelse(pmin(total_from, total_to) < 25, NA_real_, swing)) vals <- s |> transmute( geo_id, value = swing, html = sprintf( "%s
%d margin%s
%d margin%s
Swing%s
Votes%s → %s
%s", htmltools::htmlEscape(geo_titles[geo_id]), from, fmt_margin(margin_from), to, fmt_margin(margin_to), fmt_swing(swing), format(round(total_from), big.mark = ","), format(round(total_to), big.mark = ","), ifelse(estimated | (lvl == "precinct" & from < 2022) | (lvl == "district" & from < 2022), "
Includes estimated values (votes re-mapped onto current lines).
", "") ) ) list(shapes = shapes, values = vals, limit = 20, kind = "swing", estimated = from < 2022 && lvl != "county") } }) output$map <- renderLeaflet({ leaflet(options = leafletOptions(zoomSnap = 0.5, zoomDelta = 0.5)) |> addMapPane("fill", zIndex = 410) |> addMapPane("outline", zIndex = 420) |> # Esri gray canvas: keyless (CARTO basemaps now require an API key) addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldGrayCanvas, group = "Light") |> addProviderTiles(providers$OpenStreetMap, group = "Streets") |> addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery, group = "Satellite") |> addPolygons(data = filter(context_sf, type == "district"), fill = FALSE, weight = 1, color = "#888", opacity = 0.8, dashArray = "4 4", group = "Rest of Arizona", options = pathOptions(pane = "outline", interactive = FALSE)) |> addLabelOnlyMarkers(data = st_point_on_surface(filter(context_sf, type == "district", name == "AZ-9")), label = ~name, group = "Rest of Arizona", labelOptions = labelOptions(noHide = TRUE, textOnly = TRUE, style = list("color" = "#777", "font-size" = "13px"))) |> addLabelOnlyMarkers(lng = -112.07, lat = 33.45, label = "Phoenix metro (AZ-1, 3, 4, 5, 8)", group = "Rest of Arizona", labelOptions = labelOptions(noHide = TRUE, textOnly = TRUE, direction = "left", style = list("color" = "#777", "font-size" = "11px"))) |> addPolygons(data = filter(context_sf, type == "state"), fill = FALSE, weight = 2.5, color = "#555", opacity = 0.9, group = "Rest of Arizona", options = pathOptions(pane = "outline", interactive = FALSE)) |> addPolygons(data = districts_sf, fill = FALSE, weight = 3, color = "#222", opacity = 0.9, group = "District lines", options = pathOptions(pane = "outline", interactive = FALSE)) |> addLabelOnlyMarkers(data = st_point_on_surface(districts_sf), label = ~geo_id, group = "District lines", labelOptions = labelOptions(noHide = TRUE, textOnly = TRUE, style = list("font-weight" = "bold", "font-size" = "14px", "text-shadow" = "0 0 3px #fff"))) |> addCircleMarkers(lng = SIERRA_VISTA[["lng"]], lat = SIERRA_VISTA[["lat"]], radius = 7, color = "#000", weight = 2, fillColor = "#FFD200", fillOpacity = 1, label = "Sierra Vista", group = "Sierra Vista", options = pathOptions(pane = "outline")) |> addLayersControl(baseGroups = c("Light", "Streets", "Satellite"), overlayGroups = c("District lines", "Rest of Arizona", "Sierra Vista"), options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = TRUE)) |> addScaleBar(position = "bottomleft") |> addEasyButton(easyButton(icon = "fa-globe", title = "Show all three districts", onClick = JS(sprintf("function(btn, map){ map.fitBounds([[%f,%f],[%f,%f]]); }", study_bbox[2], study_bbox[1], study_bbox[4], study_bbox[3])))) |> fitBounds(study_bbox[1], study_bbox[2], study_bbox[3], study_bbox[4]) }) # Proxy updates must wait until the map widget exists in the browser map_ready <- reactiveVal(FALSE) observeEvent(input$map_zoom, map_ready(TRUE), once = TRUE) observe({ req(map_ready()) d <- map_data() shapes <- inner_join(d$shapes, d$values, by = "geo_id") if (nrow(shapes) == 0) { # e.g. 2026, which only has preliminary district-level results so far leafletProxy("map") |> clearGroup("fill") |> removeControl("legend") return() } pal <- margin_palette(d$limit) is_precinct <- input$level == "precinct" labels <- lapply(sprintf("%s
%s", htmltools::htmlEscape(geo_titles[shapes$geo_id]), if (d$kind == "margin") fmt_margin(shapes$value) else fmt_swing(shapes$value)), htmltools::HTML) leafletProxy("map") |> clearGroup("fill") |> removeControl("legend") |> addPolygons(data = shapes, group = "fill", layerId = ~geo_id, fillColor = pal(squish(shapes$value, d$limit)), fillOpacity = 0.75, color = "#ffffff", weight = if (is_precinct) 0.4 else 1.2, opacity = 1, label = labels, popup = ~html, highlightOptions = highlightOptions(weight = 3, color = "#333", bringToFront = TRUE), options = pathOptions(pane = "fill")) |> addLegend("bottomright", pal = pal, values = c(-d$limit, d$limit), layerId = "legend", bins = 5, opacity = 0.85, title = if (d$kind == "margin") paste("Margin,", year_label(sel_year())) else paste0("Swing ", sel_from(), "→", year_label(sel_to())), labFormat = if (d$kind == "margin") margin_legend_format else swing_legend_format) }) zoom_to <- function(id) { bb <- unname(st_bbox(filter(districts_sf, geo_id == id))) leafletProxy("map") |> flyToBounds(bb[1], bb[2], bb[3], bb[4]) } observeEvent(input$zoom_focus, zoom_to(input$focus)) # Clicking a district focuses it; clicking a county adds it to the trend chart observeEvent(input$map_shape_click, { id <- input$map_shape_click$id if (is.null(id)) return() if (id %in% DISTRICTS) { updateSelectInput(session, "focus", selected = id) } else if (id %in% counties_sf$geo_id && !id %in% input$trend_counties) { updateSelectizeInput(session, "trend_counties", selected = tail(c(input$trend_counties, id), 5)) } }) output$map_note <- renderUI({ d <- map_data() years_shown <- if (input$mode == "single") sel_year() else c(sel_from(), sel_to()) msgs <- c( if (any(is_prelim(years_shown)) && input$level != "district") "2026 results are only available at district level so far. County and precinct results will be added after the canvass is certified.", if (any(is_prelim(years_shown))) "2026 figures are unofficial (98–99% reporting, Nov 9–10, 2026) and only include the two major-party candidates.", if (input$level == "precinct" && input$mode == "single" && sel_year() >= 2022) "2022/2024 precinct results are matched to 2024 precinct shapes by name; unmatched precincts appear blank.", if (input$level == "county" && input$race == "House") "County House results combine every House race on the county's ballot.", if (d$estimated) "2016–2020 results are estimated onto today's district lines / precinct shapes by area.", "Click a shape for details. Click a district to focus it, or a county to add it to Trends." ) HTML(paste(msgs, collapse = " ")) }) # -- Trends --------------------------------------------------------------------- trend_df <- reactive({ geos <- c(DISTRICTS, input$trend_counties) df <- results |> filter(level %in% c("district", "county"), geo_id %in% geos) df <- if (input$trend_series == "top") { filter(df, (race == "President" & year %in% c(2016, 2020, 2024)) | (race == "Governor" & year %in% c(2018, 2022))) } else { filter(df, race == input$trend_series) } margin_summary(df) |> mutate(name = geo_titles[geo_id], name = factor(name, levels = unique(geo_titles[geos]))) |> arrange(name, year) }) output$trend_plot <- renderPlotly({ df <- trend_df() validate(need(nrow(df) > 0, "No data for this selection.")) cols <- c(district_colors, setNames(county_colors[seq_along(input$trend_counties)], geo_titles[input$trend_counties])) lim <- max(abs(df$margin), 5, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1 plot_ly(df, x = ~year, y = ~margin, color = ~name, colors = cols, type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers", line = list(width = 3), marker = list(size = 9), hovertext = ~sprintf("%s
%s %s: %s
D %s · R %s", name, year_label(year), race, fmt_margin(margin), format(round(dem), big.mark = ","), format(round(rep), big.mark = ",")), hoverinfo = "text") |> layout( xaxis = list(title = "", tickvals = sort(unique(df$year)), fixedrange = FALSE), yaxis = list(title = "R − D margin (pts)", zeroline = TRUE, zerolinewidth = 2, zerolinecolor = "#555", range = c(-lim, lim)), shapes = list( list(type = "rect", xref = "paper", x0 = 0, x1 = 1, y0 = 0, y1 = lim, fillcolor = "#C8102E", opacity = 0.05, line = list(width = 0)), list(type = "rect", xref = "paper", x0 = 0, x1 = 1, y0 = -lim, y1 = 0, fillcolor = "#1F4E9C", opacity = 0.05, line = list(width = 0)) ), legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.15), hovermode = "closest" ) |> config(displaylogo = FALSE) }) swing_years <- reactive({ if (input$mode == "change") { valid_change() c(sel_from(), sel_to()) } else { yrs <- years_for(input$race) c(min(yrs), max(yrs)) } }) output$swing_title <- renderText({ y <- swing_years() sprintf("%s swing, %d → %d", names(RACES)[RACES == input$race], y[1], y[2]) }) swing_df <- reactive({ y <- swing_years() results |> filter(level %in% c("district", "county"), race == input$race) |> swing(y[1], y[2]) |> mutate(name = geo_titles[geo_id]) |> arrange(level != "district", swing) }) output$swing_plot <- renderPlotly({ df <- swing_df() validate(need(nrow(df) > 0, "No data for this selection.")) df$name <- factor(df$name, levels = rev(df$name)) plot_ly(df, x = ~swing, y = ~name, type = "bar", orientation = "h", marker = list(color = ifelse(df$swing > 0, "#C8102E", "#1F4E9C")), hovertext = ~sprintf("%s
%s → %s
%s", name, fmt_margin(margin_from), fmt_margin(margin_to), fmt_swing(swing)), hoverinfo = "text") |> layout(xaxis = list(title = "Change in R − D margin (pts)", zeroline = TRUE, zerolinewidth = 2, zerolinecolor = "#555"), yaxis = list(title = ""), bargap = 0.3) |> config(displaylogo = FALSE) }) output$swing_table <- renderDT({ y <- swing_years() df <- swing_df() |> transmute(Geography = name, Level = tools::toTitleCase(level), !!paste("Margin", y[1]) := fmt_margin(margin_from), !!paste("Margin", y[2]) := fmt_margin(margin_to), `Change (+R / −D)` = round(swing, 1), `Votes change` = round(turnout_change), Estimated = ifelse(estimated, "yes", "")) datatable(df, rownames = FALSE, options = list(dom = "t", pageLength = 50, ordering = TRUE)) |> formatStyle("Change (+R / −D)", color = styleInterval(0, c("#1F4E9C", "#C8102E")), fontWeight = "bold") |> formatRound("Votes change", digits = 0, mark = ",") }) # -- Results / Compare ------------------------------------------------------------- output$result_plot <- renderPlotly({ df <- results |> filter(level == "district", geo_id == input$focus, race == input$race, year == shown_year()) |> group_by(candidate, party) |> summarise(votes = sum(votes), .groups = "drop") |> mutate(share = votes / sum(votes)) |> arrange(votes) |> mutate(candidate = factor(candidate, levels = candidate)) validate(need(nrow(df) > 0, "No data for this selection.")) p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = share, y = candidate, fill = party, text = sprintf("%s
%s votes (%.1f%%)", candidate, format(round(votes), big.mark = ","), 100 * share))) + geom_col(width = 0.6) + scale_fill_manual(values = party_colors) + scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) + labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = NULL, title = sprintf("%s %s, %s", input$focus, names(RACES)[RACES == input$race], shown_year())) + theme_minimal(base_size = 14) + theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()) ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text") |> config(displaylogo = FALSE) }) output$compare_plot <- renderPlotly({ df <- results |> filter(level == "district", race == input$race, year == shown_year()) |> group_by(geo_id, party) |> summarise(votes = sum(votes), .groups = "drop_last") |> mutate(share = votes / sum(votes)) |> ungroup() |> mutate(party = factor(party, levels = rev(names(party_colors))), geo_id = factor(geo_id, levels = rev(DISTRICTS))) validate(need(nrow(df) > 0, "No data for this selection.")) p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = share, y = geo_id, fill = party, text = sprintf("%s %s: %.1f%%", geo_id, party, 100 * share))) + geom_col(width = 0.6) + geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey30") + scale_fill_manual(values = party_colors, breaks = names(party_colors)) + scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent, expand = c(0, 0)) + labs(x = "Vote share", y = NULL, fill = NULL, title = sprintf("%s vote share by party, %s", names(RACES)[RACES == input$race], shown_year())) + theme_minimal(base_size = 14) + theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()) ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text") |> config(displaylogo = FALSE) }) # -- Data ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ table_data <- reactive({ lvl <- input$data_level if (input$mode == "single") { res_level <- lvl results |> filter(level == res_level, race == input$race, year == sel_year()) |> margin_summary() |> transmute(Geography = geo_titles[geo_id], Year = year, Race = race, Democratic = round(dem), Republican = round(rep), Total = round(total), Margin = fmt_margin(margin), `Margin (R−D pts)` = round(margin, 2), Estimated = estimated) } else { valid_change() res_level <- if (lvl == "precinct") "precinct_current" else lvl results |> filter(level == res_level, race == input$race) |> swing(sel_from(), sel_to()) |> transmute(Geography = geo_titles[geo_id], Race = race, !!paste("Margin", sel_from()) := round(margin_from, 2), !!paste("Margin", sel_to()) := round(margin_to, 2), `Swing (+R / −D)` = round(swing, 2), `Votes change` = round(turnout_change), Estimated = estimated) } }) output$table <- renderDT({ datatable(table_data(), rownames = FALSE, filter = "top", options = list(pageLength = 25, dom = "tip", scrollX = TRUE)) }) output$download <- downloadHandler( filename = function() { yrs <- if (input$mode == "single") sel_year() else paste(sel_from(), sel_to(), sep = "-") sprintf("sierra_vista_area_%s_%s_%s.csv", tolower(input$race), input$data_level, yrs) }, content = function(file) write.csv(table_data(), file, row.names = FALSE) ) } shinyApp(ui, server)

name: R/helpers.R
content:
# Shared helpers for app.R (Shiny sources this folder automatically). party_colors <- c( Republican = "#C8102E", Democratic = "#1F4E9C", Green = "#3A8A3F", Other = "#8C8C8C" ) # Two-party margin per geography. `margin` is (R - D) / all votes, in points: # positive = Republican lead, negative = Democratic lead. margin_summary <- function(df) { df |> group_by(level, geo_id, year, race) |> summarise( dem = sum(votes[party == "Democratic"]), rep = sum(votes[party == "Republican"]), total = sum(votes), estimated = any(estimated), .groups = "drop" ) |> mutate( margin = ifelse(total > 0, 100 * (rep - dem) / total, NA_real_), winner = case_when(rep > dem ~ "Republican", dem > rep ~ "Democratic", TRUE ~ "Tie") ) } # Change in R - D margin (points) between two elections, per geography. # Positive = shift toward Republicans. swing <- function(df, from, to) { m <- margin_summary(filter(df, year %in% c(from, to))) inner_join( filter(m, year == from) |> select(level, geo_id, race, margin_from = margin, total_from = total), filter(m, year == to) |> select(level, geo_id, race, margin_to = margin, total_to = total, estimated), by = c("level", "geo_id", "race") ) |> mutate(swing = margin_to - margin_from, turnout_change = total_to - total_from) } # "R+4.2" / "D+1.0" / "Even" fmt_margin <- function(x, digits = 1) { ifelse(is.na(x), "–", ifelse(round(x, digits) == 0, "Even", paste0(ifelse(x > 0, "R+", "D+"), formatC(abs(x), format = "f", digits = digits)))) } # "+3.1 toward R" / "+2.0 toward D" fmt_swing <- function(x, digits = 1) { ifelse(is.na(x), "–", ifelse(round(x, digits) == 0, "No change", paste0(formatC(abs(x), format = "f", digits = digits), ifelse(x > 0, " pts toward R", " pts toward D")))) } # Diverging blue <-> red scale centred at 0, symmetric around +/- limit. # Pass values through squish() first so anything past the limit takes the end colour. margin_palette <- function(limit) { leaflet::colorNumeric(c("#1F4E9C", "#9DB4DD", "#F7F7F7", "#E8A2A9", "#C8102E"), domain = c(-limit, limit), na.color = "#d9d9d9") } squish <- function(x, limit) pmax(pmin(x, limit), -limit) margin_legend_format <- function(type, cuts, p) fmt_margin(cuts, 0) swing_legend_format <- function(type, cuts, p) { ifelse(cuts == 0, "0", paste0(ifelse(cuts > 0, "R +", "D +"), abs(round(cuts)))) } # Popup HTML per geography: one line per candidate plus the margin. popup_html <- function(df, titles) { df |> group_by(geo_id, candidate, party) |> summarise(votes = sum(votes), .groups = "drop") |> group_by(geo_id) |> mutate(share = votes / sum(votes)) |> arrange(desc(votes), .by_group = TRUE) |> summarise( rows = paste0( sprintf("■ %s%s%.1f%%", party_colors[ifelse(party %in% names(party_colors), party, "Other")], htmltools::htmlEscape(candidate), format(round(votes), big.mark = ","), 100 * share), collapse = ""), total = sum(votes), .groups = "drop" ) |> mutate(html = sprintf( "%s%s
Total%s
", htmltools::htmlEscape(titles[geo_id]), rows, format(round(total), big.mark = ",") )) |> select(geo_id, html) }
